info.name: Cocos Challenge API
info.description:
# Cocos Challenge API

Postman Collection v2.1 for the live challenge API at `https://dummy-api-topaz.vercel.app`.

## Before you run

1. Import this file into Postman.
2. Confirm the collection variables `baseUrl` and `bugMode`. `bugMode` must be `off` for deterministic behavior.
3. Run the collection in order with the Collection Runner.

The collection auto-generates an anonymous `candidateId` when it is empty. The `00 - Setup` folder resets it to a brand-new candidate so a full run starts from `{ "cash": 1000000, "holdings": [] }`.

Every request sends:

```http
X-Enable-Bugs: {{bugMode}}
X-Candidate-Id: {{candidateId}}
```

Negative tests deliberately disable one required header to verify the server error. The full collection mutates the candidate portfolio; run `00 - Setup` again for a clean baseline.

## Variable overrides

- Set `candidateId` to reuse a specific candidate.
- Set `instrumentId` to trade a specific instrument instead of the first result from `/instruments`.
- Set `bugMode` only for manual QA. The application always uses `off`.
